I still have non-Brazilian friends who think São Paulo is fine to visit

We hired a great Uber driver to drive us to Florianopolis, like a 3 hour trip, cause was easier than flying then, very nice guy

While driving I sat in the back talking a bit with him and practicing my Portuguese

Then I noticed he didn't wear a seatbelt so I asked why

He said "so I can draw my gun quickly"

I said "desculpa the fuck what gun"

Then he showed he was wearing a holster on his right side with a gun it which he carried for safety because he said drive into and out of São Paulo often

So being a funny naive Dutch guy I asked "so did you ever kill someone?"

He said "yes I killed a guy last year who came at me and who tried steal my car in São Paulo"

And then he told me he was in a judicial trial about it and being prosecuted for it

I asked him again in the naive Dutch guy perspective "did you get like therapy after? like must be intense right, do you feel bad about that?

He said "no why? If I didn't kill him he would have killed me" ☠️

Foreigners especially Europeans have no clue how violent São Paulo and Rio are, it's just not in their mental framework to be able to understand the danger, Brazilians themselves are surprisingly honest and realistic about it

There a reason I stay the F out of São Paulo

I mpstly stick to South Brazil, it's safe, not as safe as Europe but mostly very safe and not really violent. The violence and crime there seems mostly isolated between gangs and in the few favelas there

About that too I asked Brazilians "why is South Brazil so safe?"

And they mostly agreed when a guy told me "because the police here shoot to kill" while in São Paulo and Rio the police is too scared to get prosecuted for killing people"

hits.draft_en: A traveler I read about still meets non-Brazilians who assume São Paulo is safe to visit. His Uber driver for the 3 hour trip to Florianopolis was a lovely guy who skipped his seatbelt so he could draw his gun fast. The driver said he had killed a man last year who tried to steal his car in São Paulo, and was being prosecuted for it, with no guilt at all: had he not killed him, the man would have killed him. Foreigners, especially Europeans, have no framework for the violence in São Paulo and Rio. That is why the traveler stays out of São Paulo and mostly sticks to South Brazil, which locals call mostly very safe, explaining that police there shoot to kill while São Paulo and Rio police fear prosecution for killing people.

NEW: OpenAI says its AI just made three major discoveries in math, computer science, and physics.

1. Local smoothing + Kakeya conjectures (math): proved in every dimension. A 35-year-old question about how waves focus.

2. Exponential Time Hypothesis (computer science): disproved. Hundreds of research papers were built on it being true

3. Existence of QCD + Yang–Mills (physics): proved. Physics' theory of the force holding atoms together now stands on solid math, including part of a $1M Millennium Prize problem. https://t.co/V2Qpf42yg8

x_keywords.method: Read-only x MCP search_posts_all, 2 calls per keyword: last 24 h and previous 24 h (24-48 h ago); lang:en, no retweets/replies, sort=relevancy, up to 25 posts per window. This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Rank = sum of sampled 24 h views; 48 h = both windows; trend = 24 h sum / previous 24 h sum (up >=1.3, down <=0.7). Fresh posts are still gaining views, so 'up' is understated. Top-post share > 70% means one viral post carries the keyword.

trend_radar.legend: Trend match 0-100% = 1 - prod(1 - w) over matched 24 h keywords that another author also used in the 48 h window (w: rank 1-10 0.35, 11-25 0.22, 26-40 0.12, curated 0.20). Verdict: >= 50% -> trend; else video/image in the post data -> visual; else >= 100K followers (outsiders without follower data: >= 500K views, estimate) -> author/audience; else coincidence/other. Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h. Trend-input-only accounts feed the corpus but are never shown as hits.
